answer_1.quote: Others follow the generation framework and generate the reply from scratch. Generation models usually follow the sequence-to-sequence framework, which generates y token by token.

answer_2.quote: Specifically, we evaluate models using a test set of message-reply pairs. ... Based on the study, we recommend weighted ROUGE F1 ensemble (ROUGE in tables), which has the highest correlation with CTR.

answer_4.quote: For our English monolingual experiments, we also complement automatic metrics with human judgments (Human in Figure ). For each example, we display the input message and sets of three suggested replies from both generation and retrieval models to three human annotators (crowd workers). We then ask the annotators to select the set with more responses that they prefer to send as a reply.
